records.statement: Binance Update #4 reports 95% aggregate replenishment, 100% coverage for XRP among the top ten, and phase-one XRP network withdrawals scheduled 06:00–09:00 UTC; no XRP-specific purchases or actual withdrawal flows are disclosed.
records.impact: Conflating company-wide replenishment, customer-asset coverage, XRP purchases and actual customer withdrawals would create false capital-flow and market-impact signals.
unresolved: XRP-specific purchase quantity, venue, price and funding source.

Customer withdrawals versus internal wallet reshuffling.
External destination types and subsequent exchange deposits/trades.
Full cryptographic Proof of Reserves and liability reconciliation.

records.statement: The latest accessible XRP Insights snapshot reports the November 1 gross 1B XRP release and zero re-escrow by ledger 108036051 at 02:31 UTC, but raw transaction metadata and Destination fields were not independently retrieved and later disposition is unknown.
records.impact: Gross release and tracker-reported net outside escrow must not be equated with exchange inflow, OTC sale, or market sell pressure.
unresolved: Raw validated-ledger transaction JSON for both EscrowFinish hashes.

records.statement: Main retains write/dispatch-capable Cross Analysis, Scheduler Tick and Merge Queue workflows. PR #1442 passes exact-head CI/gate but is open, draft and unmerged. Cross Analysis emitted zero-sample XRP/BTC sentiment shift with a new generated_at timestamp.
records.impact: Scheduled workflow capability can mutate repository state without the requested approval boundary; generated_at-only updates can misrepresent stale data as fresh.
unresolved: Explicit approval enforcement and least-privilege workflow permissions on main.
Full repository CI and dependency/security scanning.
